Party Republican; District Number blank (the office has no district). 'Is this report an amendment?' has NEITHER Yes NOR No ticked - is_amendment left blank. Signature date is handwritten 1/30/19; the clerk stamp reads RECEIVED IN OFFICE JAN 31 2019; the Summary Page and both schedules carry a Date of Report of 12/31/18 (the period end, not the signing date) - all three are recorded where they belong and none was used to fill another. THE DOCUMENT IS A STUB-PLUS-ATTACHMENT ON BOTH SIDES: p3 and p5 are the county Schedule A / Schedule B grids with the words 'See Attached' typed into the first data row and their grand-total cells filled, and the actual lines live on the filer's own sheets, p4 (Schedule A) and p6 (Schedule B). Shape = attachment-behind-stub for both sides. The p4 attachment prints columns Date Received | First Name | Last Name/Organization Name | Address | City | State | Zip Code | Occupation/Employer | Date Deposited | Contribution Amount; the Address, City, State and Zip columns are covered by ONE continuous black bar over all 13 rows, so NO donor geography survives - every row's note says 'redacted at source', which is a different fact from a filer leaving them empty. The p6 attachment prints Date of Expenditure | Name of Recipient | Purpose | Amount only - it has no address column at all, which is why the expenditure rows carry no geography note of either kind. Every date on both attachments prints a full year, so no row needed a blank date.
